title: Suppress embed-serving stragglers: sampled profiling, preemptive micro-batches, and kernel-mode routing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: reduce p99/p995 latency for the embeddings endpoint by addressing straggler RPCs and slow kernel paths without degrading median latency or per-request cost. Approach combines (1) lightweight sampled tail profiling to identify slow call patterns, (2) preemptive micro-batching that avoids long stragglers by favoring bounded batch sizes, and (3) runtime kernel-mode routing that chooses quantized or full-precision kernels based on sequence-length + cache-hit heuristics.
acceptance_criteria: 1) p99 latency for embed-text-64 model reduced by >= 20% on standard traffic mix in lab A/B tests. 2) No more than 2% regression in median latency. 3) End-to-end token cost change within +/- 5%. 4) New sampling profiler can surface top-10 straggler causes in production sampling runs. 5) Feature rollout gated behind a per-tenant toggle in console.
technical_notes:
Sampling: implement deterministic 1% sample of embed requests at the front proxy, attach lightweight trace headers and non-blocking in-memory histogram of service time by kernel path. Use reservoir sampling to keep stack samples (top-of-stack kernel id + sequence length bucket) for offline analysis.

Preemptive micro-batching: current opportunistic coalescing sometimes creates very large batches (up to 256) for embeddings when traffic spikes; those create tail latency when a single long-seq request is included. Implement bounded micro-batches with a per-worker soft cap (e.g., 32) and age threshold (10ms). Provide option for tenant-level preferred batch cap.

Kernel-mode routing: extend kernel selector to consider (seq_len, kv_cache_hit_ratio, quantization_profile) and route to a faster-int8 kernel when quantization quality estimated to be within quality budget (per-prompt quality model). Fall back to fp16 kernel for sequences flagged as high-quality-sensitive. Add CPU-side fast-path for very short sequences to avoid kernel launch overhead.

Trade-offs: sampling adds small CPU and memory overhead but is non-blocking and sampled. Bounded batching may increase nominal cost due to smaller batch utilization; we'll offset with adaptive burst policy. Kernel-mode adds complexity to model onboarding and increases matrix of kernel QA combinations.
testing_plan:
Lab A/B: run synthetic replay of production traffic (10M requests/day equivalent) against two stacks: control and with feature flags. Collect p50/p95/p99/p995 and cost per 1k tokens. Run per-tenant canary: enable on 5% of tenants for 48h and monitor error rates, latency SLOs, and quality regressions using our eval harness (50 curated eval prompts).

Unit tests: kernel selector logic, profiler sampler, batch caps. Integration tests: end-to-end embed API under variable seq len mixes. Performance tests: perf benchmarks with local GPU fleets (A100x8) and simulated network jitter.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge feature behind feature flag and run internal perf runs. 2) Start 5% tenants for 48h with enhanced telemetry. 3) If metrics pass, expand to 25% for 72h. 4) Gradual global rollout over one week. 5) If p99 worsens or errors > 0.5% above baseline, automatic rollback.

Console: add a toggle per-tenant with a short help blurb and link to docs. Add two dashboards: "Embed Straggler Sampler" and "Kernel Mode Impact".
risks_mitigation:
Risk: kernel quantization could degrade embedding quality for semantic search. Mitigation: conservative selection rules; require per-model quality pass; expose tenant opt-out.

Risk: bounded micro-batches increase per-token GPU cost. Mitigation: adaptive batch cap that steps down only when tail triggers; measure unit economics before rollout.

Risk: profiler sampling overhead. Mitigation: keep sample rate configurable and default to 0.5% if CPU pressure observed.

2026-03-12 Jun Park: Scheduler patch (PR #4891) implements soft per-worker batch cap and age threshold. Local bench shows p99 reduction from 210ms -> 170ms in synthetic mix (seq distribution: 70% short <128, 25% mid 128-512, 5% long >512). Need QA on cost impact.

2026-03-13 Priya Rao: Kernel selector change PR #4915 added quantization-eligibility checks and a short-seq CPU fast-path. Observed median latency unchanged, p99 improved in lab by ~18%. Added unit tests for selector logic.
2026-03-14 Maya Chen: Started 5% tenant canary. Initial 3h telemetry shows p99 down 16% and median +1% latency; no quality regressions on eval harness for the first pass. Monitoring for next 48h.
